services.name: Memphis Mojo Tour: the Best of Memphis
services.desc: High-energy 90-minute musical city bus tour of Memphis led by Beale Street musicians with live music, history, and comedy.

services.name: Memphis Mojo Tour with Sun Studio admission
services.desc: High-energy 3-hour musical city tour of Memphis that includes a guided visit to Sun Studio and live commentary by professional Beale Street musicians.

services.name: Memphis Mojo Tour with Stax Museum admission
services.desc: High-energy 3-hour musical city tour of Memphis with live music and admission to the Stax Museum of American Soul Music.

services.name: Memphis Discovery Tour: Explore, Taste, Shop
services.desc: All-inclusive Memphis tour combining history, attraction hopping, and a Central BBQ tasting to showcase the city’s highlights.

services.name: Memphis Discovery Tour with Riverboat Cruise
services.desc: Extended Memphis city tour with museum admission of your choice and a paddlewheel cruise on the Mississippi River.

services.name: Elvis Presley's Memphis: Hound Dog Tour
services.desc: Key points about this tour: A high-energy concert and sightseeing tour all rolled into one 3 hour tour includes stop and souvenir from the Memphian Theater (legendary Elvis site!) Whether you're a longtime fan or a new admirer, we guarantee fun for all! Tour Times Check our calendar for availability Duration 3 hour tour Meeting Place and Check In Time Alfred's on Beale at Beale & BB King Blvd GPS Address 197 Beale St, Memphis, TN 38103 Arrive 15 minutes prior to the tour The two most convenient garages are located on: (1) Peabody Place, between 2nd and 3rd Streets; and (2) Second Street, between Beale St. and Lt. services.name: Historic Memphis Walking Tour: Memphis Beyond Beale
services.desc: Guided walking tour of historic downtown Memphis led by professional local guides.

services.name: Beale Street Walking Tour
services.desc: Guided one-hour walking tour exploring the history, legends, and culture of Beale Street, the “Home of the Blues.”

services.name: Memphis True Crime Tour
services.desc: A 90-minute twilight bus tour of Memphis exploring notorious crimes, killers, scandals, and unsolved mysteries led by a local guide.

services.name: Memphis Walking Ghost Tour
services.desc: A 90-minute guided walking tour exploring haunted sites and spooky stories throughout Downtown Memphis, including a stop inside Ernestine & Hazel's.
